correctness.rationale: For every r>=1 and all k>=1, the cited path homotopy theorem concentrates integral homology in degree rk-1 at n=(r+2)k-1 or (r+2)k. Signed reduced Lefschetz contributions are exactly minus one per vertex-orbit monomial; the palindromic half-word formulas enumerate all such faces without omissions. The explicit (r+1)-state matrix satisfies T^(r+2)=(-1)^r I by Cayley--Hamilton; its initial signed word values give both k=1 and k=2 base characters, hence every k. Standalone finite face and boundary checks replay successfully.
